parsed.name: 泰克示波器
parsed.description: 用于实验中采集和读取电信号波形的泰克示波器。证据显示该设备通过 VISA 接口通信，并支持与波形前导信息、响应终止符、查询超时及 16 位整数波形下载相关的配置。
parsed.description_en: A Tektronix oscilloscope used in laboratory experiments to acquire and read electrical signal waveforms. The evidence indicates communication over a VISA interface, with configuration related to waveform preamble format, response termination, query timeout, and 16-bit integer waveform downloads.

actions.description: 生成并写入该示波器在实验运行中使用的配置代码。
actions.description_en: Generate and write the configuration code used for this oscilloscope in an experiment run.
